summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 results. The filing contains standard quarterly financial performance, including net sales of R$16.7 billion, adjusted EBITDA of R$3.0 billion, and approval of R$354.1 million in dividends (R$0.18 per share). It also notes progress on a share buyback program, with 21% of authorized shares acquired. There is no mention of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine earnings release.
